crossRefs.note: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart…
Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that Yahweh spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,
Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image…
Be careful, lest your heart be deceived, and you turn away to serve other gods and worship them;
Take good heed therefore to yourselves, that you love Yahweh your God.
Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
He said to them, “Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you, and more will…
Be careful therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn’t have, from him will be…
Take heed, therefore, to yourselves, and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd…
Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.
looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up…
lest there be any sexually immoral person, or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.
Don’t carry a burden out of your houses on the Sabbath day. Don’t do any work, but make the Sabbath day holy, as I…
While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.
In those days I saw some men treading wine presses on the Sabbath in Judah, bringing in sheaves, and loading donkeys…
Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now it was the Sabbath on that day.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Yahweh says, “Be careful, and bear no burden on the Sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: This is what the LORD says: Take heed for yourselves; do not carry a load or bring it through the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the LORD; Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem;
translations.asv: Thus saith Jehovah, Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem;
